title: ClosureHandler.call_fn wrapped in Arc unnecessarily; handler is already in Arc
description: lib.rs:78-84, 193, 199: the macro creates Arc::new(ClosureHandler { call_fn: Arc::new(move |...| ...) }). The closure is wrapped in Arc even though ClosureHandler itself is Arc'd. The outer Arc makes the handler cloneable across tasks; the inner Arc on call_fn is an extra indirection that costs an extra allocation per handler registration with no benefit. Box<CallFn<B>> (a single allocation) would suffice. The type alias CallFn is defined but not exposed, so this is an internal change. Fix: change call_fn: Arc<CallFn<B>> to call_fn: Box<CallFn<B>>.
